decisions.reason: The pre-weld finishing decision for surfaces 1 and 2 does not change the bushing location, retention, clearance, sliding interface, or unresolved hole decision.
The surface-finishing sequence does not change the drawing template, numbering, layout, or presentation conventions.
The decision changes assembly face finishing but leaves the obligation to deliver a 3D model and its required file formats unchanged.
The source specifies when two surfaces must be finalized but does not change any dimension-annotation requirement or existing candidate attribute.
The manufacturing drawing deliverable remains required unchanged; the specific face-finishing rule is already owned by the welded-lug geometry Requirement.
